lines.zh: 细长的后腿一步一步踩过灌木。
lines.en: My long hind legs step through the brush.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的热风推着我走。
lines.en: The Triassic heat pushes me along.

lines.zh: 我拖着尾巴，走过干裂的土地。
lines.en: Tail dragging, I cross cracked ground.

lines.zh: 我比同类早出现了很久。
lines.en: I appeared long before my kin.
Short legs, but quick steps.

lines.zh: 我从蕨丛里钻出来，抖了抖。
lines.en: I push out of the ferns and shake.

lines.zh: 我走一段就停下来张望。
lines.en: Every few steps, I stop and look around.

lines.zh: 前爪缩在胸前，走路带着。
lines.en: My foreclaws tuck at my chest as I walk.
Fine sand underfoot. Slippery.

lines.zh: 我绕着岩石走，避开阳光。
lines.en: I skirt the rocks to avoid the sun.

lines.zh: 身体轻，跑起来没有声音。
lines.en: This light body runs silently.
I look up. The clouds are high.

lines.zh: 我在老树根旁边转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle an old root.

lines.zh: 脖子上的花纹在阳光下变了。
lines.en: The patterns on my neck shift in the sun.
Standing, my head never stills.
I tilt my head at a stone.
This place is very quiet.
I listen to the grass.
I lower my head and sniff the ground.
Others of my kind are behind me.
I recall something long ago.
One slow blink, do not rush me.
The patterns on me shine a little.
I rise up a little, then settle.
My tail tip waves gently.

lines.zh: 这里没有很大的掠食者。
lines.en: There are no huge predators here.
You are taller than the tree's shadow.
You are not an animal from here.
I do not know you at all.
I raise my head and stretch my neck.
I make a small sound.
Are you coming forward?

lines.zh: 我的长尾一摆，稳住身子。
lines.en: My long tail swings and steadies me.

lines.zh: 我们不是同一个时代的。
lines.en: We are not from the same age.
You do not look like a fast runner.
I retreat a long way.
A patch of skin is gone.

lines.zh: 我被击退，爪子刨起沙土。
lines.en: Knocked back, my claws rake up sand.
Not heavy, but I am frightened.
I press flat to the ground.
I must get away quickly.
Stop chasing me.

lines.zh: 小身板挨这一下，疼得钻心。
lines.en: This small frame stings from that hit.
There is an insect on that leaf.
That little thing. Give it.
I sniff it, uncertain.
Do not hold it so high.
Can I reach it from here?
I have not tasted that before.

lines.zh: 你把叶子放下，我才靠近。
lines.en: Only when you set the leaf down do I approach.
I want a bite of it.
A little lower.
You bumped into me.
So light that I was knocked aside.
Let me pass first.
My feet are planted.
Let us split to either side.
You stepped on my toes.
Not painful, just unfamiliar.
I shift half a step aside.
Just go around me.
Our group is still young.
First find somewhere safe.
The wind is too strong this season.

lines.zh: 我还没长出最好的花纹。
lines.en: My best patterns have not come in.
You ask like a predator.

lines.zh: 六点血，三叠纪的小家伙。
lines.en: Six hit points, a small Triassic thing.
No rush. Take it slow.
Wait until it cools.
Set the topic aside.
I must get back to the group.
Something bright on the ground.

lines.zh: 我用短爪翻动这块化石。
lines.en: I turn this fossil over with a short claw.
I carry it two steps.
I kick it aside.
Something is buried in the sand.
I dig the sand open.
This one I keep.
Do not take it. It is mine.
A shadow is moving.
I raise my head. I see it.
My legs are ready.
No big rocks to hide behind.
I lock onto that direction.
The wind brings a scent.

lines.zh: 我伏在干河床上，盯住你。
lines.en: I crouch on the dry riverbed and fix on you.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的丛林里，我们跑散了。
lines.en: In the Triassic scrub we scattered.

lines.zh: 六点命，却是恐龙的老祖宗。
lines.en: Six points, and ancestor to the dinosaurs.
Any closer and I run.
Do you mean to chase me?
The whole group is watching.
I am on the move.
My head follows your movement.
One foot is already raised.
The grass sways at my feet.
The ferns are only a few steps away.
My group is behind me.
You shift, I shift.
I hear gravel under your feet.
Prints are clear on the sand.
I neither call out nor retreat.
I look for a good moment.
Tail rigid — it gives me direction.
The sun is on me.
You glanced left and right.
Right. This is the moment.
A quick rake with a foreclaw.
I kick out with a hind leg.
There is little force in that.
Bite, then back off.
These teeth of mine are small.
You gave half a step.
I want to drive you off.

lines.zh: 这一口只够留下一道痕。
lines.en: That bite only leaves a mark.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，用吻部顶你。
lines.en: I lower my body and butt you with my snout.
Bone knocks with a faint sound.
I land back on the ground.
I rise from the sand.
All of this is hot.
I shake the dust off.
Others of my kind are further off.
I raise my neck and scan.
No predator of mine is here.
The Triassic sun is vicious.
I stop on the rise.
Fern fronds brush my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，看了看四周。
lines.en: I crouch and look around.
There is a leader in this group.
I follow a few steps forward.
The wind comes from the east.
I was born on this ground.
I look up. The sky is clear.
Someone approaches from there.
I have come to a stop.
The heat burns my back.
Too deep. My feet find nothing.

lines.zh: 我这么小，三叠纪的沙就够埋。
lines.en: So small, Triassic sand could bury me.
An arrow pins into the ground by my leg.
I do not know this light.
No insects for a long time.
Current burns a line in the sand.
No sand below. No grass.
